directive.exactQuestion: Why does deterministic Deep Resolver routing continue to emit unresolved_material_contradiction for items whose immutable Resolver evidence already closes the same contradiction?
directive.whyItMatters: The live Resolver queue contains 45 items and continues to route materially unchanged contradictions, creating anti-repeat work and consuming judgment capacity while root-owner underwriting gaps remain elsewhere.
directive.preferredEvidencePath: Compare the live routing queue and learning state against immutable Resolver dispositions, beginning with AA-20260921T143353Z-deep-resolver.json.
lawfulFallbacks: Defer remaining Alpha/Beta-owned evidence gaps to their root owners
Escalate deterministic reconciliation consumption semantics to Chief if the machine cannot consume resolved dispositions without methodology change
directive.successCondition: A future deterministic reconcile no longer routes an unchanged contradiction after immutable Resolver evidence marks it resolved, unless the input signature contains materially new conflicting evidence or Chief explicitly reopens it.

finding: This is a cross-lane routing deadlock, not a new company-evidence contradiction. AA is the clearest current proof: the live queue still owns unresolved_material_contradiction even though the latest immutable Resolver evidence explicitly says Council Beta introduced no materially different contradiction and recommends removing Resolver ownership unless a future input signature materially changes. The learning contract independently requires changed strategy after repeated failure and deferral of dependent symptoms to root owners. No dependency role cycle exists and no Assist Bus request targets Deep Resolver. Resolver therefore must not re-adjudicate the same company contradiction. The earliest unresolved methodology/implementation dependency is deterministic reconciliation consumption of immutable Resolver dispositions.
repeatedBlocker: Deterministic routing/reconciliation does not consume an existing resolved Resolver disposition when constructing unresolved_material_contradiction ownership.
failedStrategy: Repeated company-level Resolver re-adjudication of materially unchanged contradictions after immutable resolution.
changedStrategy: Stop company-level repetition and escalate one precise system directive: deterministic reconciliation must consume the newest applicable immutable Resolver disposition before emitting unresolved_material_contradiction, while reopening only on materially changed conflicting input or explicit Chief adjudication.
recommendedDisposition: Chief should adjudicate or authorize the deterministic consumer rule: newest applicable immutable Resolver disposition closes the same contradiction signature for routing purposes; materially changed evidence may reopen it. Do not weaken T0 evidence, provenance, causal, score, Beast, or promotion gates.
